high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "outstanding.screenplays." The post was made 17 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 4:04 PM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner. The post features a quote attributed to Quentin Tarantino. The quote reads: "EMOTION WILL ALWAYS WIN OVER COOLNESS AND CLEVERNESS. IT'S WHEN A SCENE WORKS EMOTIONALLY AND IT'S COOL AND CLEVER, THEN IT'S GREAT. THAT'S WHAT YOU WANT." Quentin Tarantino The quote is presented on a light blue background
